title: A Survey on the Organization and Operation of Level II/III Neonatal Intensive Care Units in Greece: Comparison Between 2004 and 2022
content: Background/Objectives: Limited data exist on the organization and operation of Level II/III Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICUs) in Greece; this retrospective cross-sectional survey explored their structure and functioning in 2004 and 2022. Methods: A structured questionnaire was utilized, along with demographic and perinatal data obtained from the Hellenic Statistical Authority.
